For [platform](/docs/shell/commands/categories/platform/).

<div class='command-title'>Clear the terminal screen.</div>

## Command Type

`built-in`

## Signature

```> clear {flags} ```

## Flags

 -  `--keep-scrollback, -k`: Do not clear the scrollback history.


## Input/output types:

| input   | output  |
| ------- | ------- |
| nothing | nothing |
## Examples

Clear the terminal.
```nu
> clear

```

Clear the terminal but not its scrollback history.
```nu
> clear --keep-scrollback

```

## Notes
By default clears the current screen and the off-screen scrollback buffer.
